items.title: Albania Protests Enter Day 5 As 167 Are Arrested, 132 Police Officers Injured
items.snippet: Anti-government protests in Albania's capital, Tirana, have entered their fifth consecutive day, with clashes erupting near Prime Minister Edi Rama's office. Protesters threw rocks, petrol bombs and fireworks as police responded with tear gas, water cannon and baton charges. Police said 167 people had been arrested and 132 officers injured, while seven officers were suspended pending investigation
